interpretation.next: Do not pursue a blind global hot-expert remap. Next useful work is layer-specific route policy and finding why current endpoint cannot benefit from scratch reuse despite the isolated MoE microbench gap.
interpretation.preallocated_gap: Across row1 route/synthetic checks, preallocated staged scratch is about 61-76 us faster than xpu_fused_moe, but the endpoint mixed-workspace path was already rejected because full-model decode did not improve.
interpretation.row1: For actual single-stream decode shape, route replay is within roughly -4.9% to +5.2% of synthetic depending on layer; hot packing is +2.4% for layer8 but -8.0% for layer20 in this measurement.
interpretation.row16: At rows=16, real routes are much faster than synthetic because active experts are far fewer than synthetic uniform. Hot packing is only a small additional win, about 1-2%, in the r100 check.
